labels.name: bug
labels.rationale: Reports a deadlock in Rich's Live/Console locking, described as unexpected behaviour.

labels.name: more information needed
labels.rationale: No runnable example; stack dumps and a lock-order theory are not a reproduction.

body:
To move this forward, please share a minimal runnable script that reproduces the deadlock: `Live(..., redirect_stdout=True, redirect_stderr=True, auto_refresh=True)` with threads or tasks writing to stdout/stderr, using no third-party packages if possible. Stack dumps are helpful, but a reproduction is what we can check. Your Rich version and platform are noted; please also paste the output of `python -m rich.diagnose`.

Live's redirect behaviour is described in the [Redirecting stdout / stderr](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/live.rst) section of the Live docs. Related earlier reports: #927 (deadlock when exiting Live or Status) and #3125 (redirected output inside Live).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
